newsitem.title: USA: Tesoro to buy back up to three million shrs.
newsitem.headline: Tesoro to buy back up to three million shrs.

text.p: The Tesoro Petroleum Corp said Wednesday that its board of directors authorized the repurchase of up to 3 million shares of common stock, about 11 percent of outstanding shares, in a buyback program that will extend through the end of 1998.
The company said it believes its stock is significantly undervalued and buying represents an attractive investment opportunity.
Tesoro shares were trading at 12-1/8 Wednesday afternnon.

Under the buyback program, the company will repurchase Tesoro common stock in the open market and through privately negotiated transactions, depending on price, market conditions and other factors. The purchases, said Tesoro, will be made primarily from cash flow.
